tasks.CheckBaseCase: Check if base case is met, return 0 if true.
tasks.DefineFunction: Define the function with parameters n (length of array), k (index after i), i (current index), arr (input array).
tasks.FindMaxSumSubseq: Recursively find the maximum sum of increasing subsequence from prefix till ith index.
tasks.IncludeKthElement: Include kth element in the sum if it's greater than current max and i < k.
tasks.InitializeVariables: Initialize variables to store maximum sum and temporary sums.
